verdicts.reason: A: the order reads left to right sensibly (logo, headline, tagline/date, product, CTA), but the four pills are stacked into a cramped vertical tower in which RSVP Free is just another tiny pill, and the missing partner-mark placeholder has been blown up into a prominent broken box on the right. B: the headline runs almost into the tagline column, 'Saturday 21 June' wraps awkwardly onto two lines jammed against the time copy, and the 2x2 pill grid plus the tiny body text make the middle cramped and hard to read; the placeholder is smaller but the layout is more crowded overall.
